what: Shopify Blog states that Shopify users "own the customer experience" with customizable stores and lower transaction fees, while "Etsy's transaction fee of 6.5% per sale can affect your profits."
verbatim_snippet: "Shopify users own the customer experience. You have full control over the look and feel of your store, with customizable no-code store designs. Your store features and back office tools offer advanced functionality, thanks to thousands of tailor-made apps for product sourcing, subscriptions, dropshipping, and more. Etsy's transaction fee of 6.5% per sale can affect your profits. Keep more revenue from your sales with Shopify's competitive pricing and lower transaction fees."
notes: Published by Shopify (direct competitor, inherent advocacy). Not directly fetched; verbatim from search snippet. Comparison dimension: customer experience ownership, transaction fees. Other platform: Shopify. Stance: advocacy for Shopify. Numbers: 6.5% Etsy transaction fee. Affiliate disclosure: published by Shopify. Third-party comparative sub-type (SD-06).
